svg.aria-label: Every tool call follows eight steps: application call, registry lookup, policy check, per-call approval, credential injection, executor, response size guardrail, and an outcome event.
svg.title: Every tool call follows eight steps: application call, registry lookup, policy check, per-call approval, credential injection, executor, response size guardrail, and an outcome event.
svg.text: 1. Application
matimo.execute('calculator', { operation: 'add', a: 5, b: 3 }, options?)
2. ToolRegistry lookup
Unknown name: TOOL_NOT_FOUND
3. Policy: canExecute(context, tool)
Risk: low (GET), medium (POST, PUT, PATCH), high (DELETE, command, requires_approval)
Function tools use their declared risk
Denied (deprecated, draft without admin, production role check): tool:execution_denied, POLICY_DENIED
Quarantined (enableHITL and risk at or above hitlMinRiskLevel): approval manifest, else onHITL callback
Events: tool:quarantine_approved, tool:quarantine_rejected
4. Per-call approval
Needed when: requires_approval: true; HTTP DELETE or command tool without requires_approval
(secure mode); destructive keyword in params.sql (or params.command for command tools)
Skipped when: the name matches MATIMO_APPROVED_PATTERNS, or options.approved is true
Asks: options.onApproval, then instance onApproval, then global callback, else reject
Events: tool:approval_granted, tool:approval_denied
5. Credentials
Fill auth placeholders from options.credentials, else environment variables
An unfilled placeholder fails with a clear error
6. Executor, by execution.type
function: import the tool's module and call it with { credentials, policyContext }
http: build the request, re-check the final URL for SSRF, send
command: spawn the process with templated args
7. Response size guardrail
Caps the result to output_schema.max_response_size, else the instance default, else 256 KB
Arrays are sliced with a "...truncated, N of M items shown" sentinel
Long strings get an inline marker; large objects are truncated per field and marked _truncated: true
8. Outcome event, then return
tool:executed { durationMs, success, riskLevel, traceId }
or tool:execution_failed { errorCode, error }
Both go to onEvent and the auditSink
